d:
Working on the more accurate English translation now. IF you want the official, less accurate English translation, let me know and I'll post that as an appetizer while you guys wait for my version.

Lime's note:

This time, I drew Rangiku Matsumoto from Bleach.

This is a manga adaptation of the previously released Erocos Dream 21, with a revised story.

I wanted to create a sense of shame with the costume, so I changed it to a more revealing v-string. Rangiku's hairstyle is still difficult to draw and I haven't fully grasped it yet, but since I've drawn her many times, I think I managed to capture her essence fairly well.

The main story hasn't changed, but the opening scene has been depicted in more detail. I also drew Hitsugaya as a bonus, but it was my first time drawing him so it was a bit of a struggle (lol).

This concludes my 2nd Rangiku doujinshi. I hope you enjoyed it.
